set.body:
Work key: W01.2
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate target: docs/local-demo-plan.md
Accountable role: Backend and frontend engineers
Program scope: required

Scope: Deliver approved native-BIDS staging through bounded authenticated workflows for the local engineering baseline; later institutional intake extensions require explicit additional work.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Implement L01.1’s approved native-BIDS staging through opaque registered source IDs, with explicit file count/size/type limits and source identity; browser callers never submit arbitrary filesystem paths.
2. Reject traversal, symlinks/unsafe names, changed sources, duplicate/conflicting chunks or unverified bytes as applicable to the chosen mode.
3. Resume after interruption with current authorization and capacity reservations; cancel/expiry reclaim only eligible staging and never accepted blobs.

Verification: Interrupted large-file/many-file transport fixtures, digest/size checks, source-change tests and measured staging resource use.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/W01.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

References:
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/NativeRepository.scala
- docs/http-api.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- W01.1: bd-01M4W5PACGC0YY1Q22W0AVAFCH
- L01.1: bd-01M4X5MA1AAA6MXNK2PWBAYYP1

Completion rule: satisfy every criterion with observed, source-bound evidence. Local fixtures and engineering checks cannot replace institutional approval, real-provider qualification, human accessibility or operator acceptance. No external outreach is authorized by this task.
set.title: W01.2: Implement bounded and resumable native staging intake
